candidates.title: Rain-Damaged Lantern
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered their lantern had gone dark just before the evening procession before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they replaced the wick, but water kept dripping onto the flame; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a narrow crack around the glass cover was letting in the rain; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they sealed the crack with resin and carried the relit lantern to the procession, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Missing Storybook
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the children's storybook had vanished from its wooden box before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they searched the reading tent, but only an empty ribbon was left behind; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a scrap of matching ribbon was caught beneath a loose bench; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they lifted the bench together and returned the book before story time, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Runaway Festival Ball
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the festival's painted ball rolled downhill toward a flooded ditch before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they chased it directly, but the slippery bank forced them to stop; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a fallen branch could guide the ball into a shallow puddle instead; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the stranded travelers watching, they positioned the branch safely and recovered the ball without entering the ditch, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
